tags: [t018-frontmatter-tag]

This page links to tags that no other t018 pages use, including tags with accents and in other scripts, and tags right after punctuation. Its frontmatter adds the tag `t018-frontmatter-tag`, which is shown as a tag link at the top of the page, as Obsidian shows frontmatter tags.

#t018-unique-a

Here is a sentence with an embedded tag: #t018-unique-b and some other words.

And another embedded tag at the end of the line: #t018-unique-c

A tag with an accent: #café-t018

A tag in Japanese: #日本語-t018

A tag in parentheses: (#t018-unique-d)

A tag in bold: **#t018-unique-e**

### A heading with a tag #t018-heading-tag

A tag in a heading is a tag, as in Obsidian.
